caveats: City counts describe the single U.S. base assigned to each organization, not every physical branch.
All-state representation did not establish comprehensive coverage within any state.
Published operating-program evidence is weaker than a dated current exhibition; a live site alone does not prove current operation.
Regional art-walk districts, university and municipal galleries, and nonmember artist-run cooperatives were not systematically enumerated.
